capabilities: Launch a Continuity Sketch drawing session on a nearby iPad
Insert the finished sketch image at the cursor position
Configure a custom path to the boofa-sketch helper binary
extras: Requires macOS 12.0+ and a separately installed helper binary (boofa-sketch); the plugin warns it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand-draw on an iPad with Apple Pencil and drop the resulting sketch into a note.
summary: Drawing tool that captures a sketch made on a nearby iPad with Apple Pencil via Apple Continuity and inserts it as an image at the cursor (macOS only).
